metadata.title: CrowdStrike, Palo Alto and Cloudflare Lead Cybersecurity Stocks Rally on PHP Flaws<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Website PHP Flaws Spur a Cybersecurity Stock Rally—but Not All Are Buys
Companies and governments around the world scrambled this week to take down or update websites amid revelations that a widely used programming language had critical vulnerabilities that could be exploited in AI-assisted attacks.
